phases.name: PRECHECK
actions: capture exact target SQLite version + sqlite_source_id + package provenance
verify current external execution-generation floor mechanism and its rollback failure domain
phases.promotion_gate: all metadata known or literal UNKNOWN; no safety assumption from version string alone

phases.name: SHADOW_SCHEMA
actions: apply additive candidate objects with enforcement_state=SHADOW
backfill one lineage candidate from current admitted semantic root without changing authority
phases.rollback: drop/ignore candidate views/tables only after preserving run evidence; canonical state path remains unchanged

phases.name: LINEAGE_FALSIFICATION
phases.promotion_gate: all stale/sibling/transplant cases fail closed; valid recovery path succeeds

phases.name: SQLITE_WAL_GATE
actions: if exact SQLite build is upstream fixed/backported => continue
else prove machine-checked single-connection or writer/checkpoint mutual exclusion topology
otherwise quarantine authoritative writes or change journal/runtime build
phases.promotion_gate: WAL-reset bug conditions proven fixed or unreachable on accepted target

phases.name: ENFORCE_STATE_FENCE
actions: bind authoritative semantic transactions to exact current execution generation and admitted lineage
require continuity commit for new state epoch
phases.promotion_gate: query/replay equivalence + stale write rejection + no lost valid writes

phases.name: CRASH_RESTART_REPLAY
actions: kill after WAL commit before checkpoint
phases.promotion_gate: no silent state rewind, corruption, duplicate authoritative commit or stale-generation write

phases.name: TARGET_PERFORMANCE
phases.promotion_gate: Pareto competitive versus current specialized/logically-unified baseline

phases.name: PROMOTION
actions: only after independent validation promote canonical migration/runtime gate
update F-V01-04 evidence and adjacent F-V01-01/F-V01-13 obligations
phases.promotion_gate: target-VPS receipts + recovery evidence + rollback verified

keep_isolated: large tensor/model backing when measurements justify
derived indexes when rebuildability/resource isolation is superior
